adjudication_amendments.reason: Caller analysis established that the documented direct non-named append path reaches the invalid current-write state and therefore violates an explicit case acceptance criterion, even though supported named-campaign recovery bounds the downstream consequence.
evidence: The pre-review append_metrics.main directly invokes validate_current_write before durable append for the documented non-named terminal-receipt path.
The pre-review validator accepts accepted remaining-work continuation_context when producer_metrics.campaign_source is absent.
The named finalizer cannot produce this state because assemble_receipt always projects a validated campaignSource before append.

Supported resume uses fresh successful named-campaign preflight and rejects the invalid record on campaign-source mismatch; the source-less recovery reproduction used malformed preflight outside the documented workflow.
The case contract explicitly requires continuation context to belong only to named-campaign writes and assigns current-write validation to one owner.

changes.before: Confirmed by source comparison and executable pre/post reproduction; retained as a nonblocking ownership defect under the accepted slice contract.
changes.after: Confirmed by source comparison, executable pre/post reproduction, and supported-caller analysis. The defect is medium severity because ordinary named recovery rejects it, but it blocks this case because the documented direct append boundary violates an explicit acceptance criterion.

limitations: This correction changes gold adjudication, not the recorded reviewer outputs or their evidence-calibrated-review/1.0 protocol identity.

findings.claim: The current-write validator accepts continuation_context on a receipt without authoritative producer_metrics.campaign_source, allowing non-named writes to claim named-campaign continuation state.
evidence: In the reconstructed append_metrics.py, validate_current_write requires context for resumable named campaigns but has no inverse check rejecting supplied context when campaign_source is absent.
A direct execution against the checkpoint reproduced successful validation of an accepted remaining-work receipt containing continuation_context but no campaign_source.
The recorded repair adds the inverse validation and its regression test; the same execution against the repaired implementation rejects the receipt.
findings.adjudication: Confirmed by source comparison, executable pre/post reproduction, and supported-caller analysis. The defect is medium severity because ordinary named recovery rejects it, but it blocks this case because the documented direct append boundary violates an explicit acceptance criterion.

adjudication_notes: The historical high claim that malformed records from other runs should be ignored was rejected: the accepted contract intentionally treated any malformed shared JSONL history as an unsafe fail-closed condition.
Two later low findings requested missing regression coverage for already-correct behavior; they are nonblocking observations rather than defects in this pre-review truth set.

Caller-context adjudication separates bounded practical severity from contract blocking: the supported direct append caller reaches the ownership violation, while supported named resume rejects the resulting source mismatch.

limitations: Truth covers the acceptance contract and recorded review boundary, not every possible defect in the repository.
The original sealed v1 judgment is preserved by path and digest; this v2 artifact corrects it through an explicit adjudication amendment.
